verdict: Local discovery surged; paid channels are dark and need restarting.
narrative: This period, all activity came from organic local search — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran zero spend, zero clicks, and zero leads for the full 28 days. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile saw a 433% spike in activity over the past week, with 51 profile actions including 31 direction requests and 19 website clicks, which shows real local interest in your practice. However, only 1 call came from those 51 actions, and website sessions dipped 30% in the most recent days, suggesting that local discovery is not yet converting into contact. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to add a reliable lead flow alongside the organic momentum you're already building.
